\section[(dialogue)]{Work, school and free time — a first pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R116-first-pass-work-school-and-free-time}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a drawing and life.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a strawberry, a cherry, a melon, garlic, flour
  \item chocolate, a biscuit, a sandwich, a sauce, vinegar
  \item a meal, a yoghurt, ice cream, a steak, ham
  \item juice, a peach, jam, a walnut, pepper
  \item a nurse, a cook, a police officer, a shop assistant, a farmer
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A strawberry? (\textbf{la fragola}.) A cherry? (\textbf{la ciliegia}.) A melon? (\textbf{il melone}.) Garlic? (\textbf{l'aglio}.) Flour? (\textbf{la farina}.) Chocolate? (\textbf{il cioccolato}.) A biscuit? (\textbf{il biscotto}.) A sandwich? (\textbf{il panino}.) A sauce? (\textbf{la salsa}.) Vinegar? (\textbf{l'aceto}.) A meal? (\textbf{il pasto}.) A yoghurt? (\textbf{lo yogurt}.) Ice cream? (\textbf{il gelato}.) A steak? (\textbf{la bistecca}.) Ham? (\textbf{il prosciutto}.) Juice? (\textbf{il succo}.) A peach? (\textbf{la pesca}.) Jam? (\textbf{la marmellata}.) A walnut? (\textbf{la noce}.) Pepper? (\textbf{il pepe}.) A nurse? (\textbf{l'infermiera}.) A cook? (\textbf{il cuoco}.) A police officer? (\textbf{il poliziotto}.) A shop assistant? (\textbf{il commesso}.) A farmer? (\textbf{il contadino}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Nature and animals — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R116-second-pass-nature-and-animals}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a baker and a driver.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a baker, a driver, a lawyer, an engineer, a firefighter
  \item a postman, a waiter, a customer, a till, a class
  \item a lesson, an exam, a word, a board, a rubber
  \item homework, an answer, a problem, a sentence, a page
  \item music, a film, a song, a drawing, life
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A baker? (\textbf{il fornaio}.) A driver? (\textbf{l'autista}.) A lawyer? (\textbf{l'avvocato}.) An engineer? (\textbf{l'ingegnere}.) A firefighter? (\textbf{il pompiere}.) A postman? (\textbf{il postino}.) A waiter? (\textbf{il cameriere}.) A customer? (\textbf{il cliente}.) A till? (\textbf{la cassa}.) A class? (\textbf{la classe}.) A lesson? (\textbf{la lezione}.) An exam? (\textbf{l'esame}.) A word? (\textbf{la parola}.) A board? (\textbf{la lavagna}.) A rubber? (\textbf{la gomma}.) Homework? (\textbf{i compiti}.) An answer? (\textbf{la risposta}.) A problem? (\textbf{il problema}.) A sentence? (\textbf{la frase}.) A page? (\textbf{la pagina}.) Music? (\textbf{la musica}.) A film? (\textbf{il film}.) A song? (\textbf{la canzone}.) A drawing? (\textbf{il disegno}.) Life? (\textbf{la vita}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
